description: Source code for a decrypting media decoder implementation for Windows, involving DRM handling, sample creation, and decryption activation.

classes.name: DecryptingDecoder
classes.description: A class implementing a decrypting media decoder with DRM support for Windows.

methods.name: CreateSample
methods.description: Creates an IMF sample from raw data and timestamp.

methods.name: AttachDrmDataToSample
methods.description: Attaches DRM-related data such as key ID and IV to an IMF sample.

methods.name: TryWriteInputBuffer
methods.description: Attempts to write an input buffer into the decoder, handling DRM decryption if necessary.

methods.name: ProcessAndRead
methods.description: Processes decoder output and decryptor output, returning available samples.

methods.name: ActivateDecryptor
methods.description: Activates and configures the decryptor with the decoder.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the decoder and decryptor state.
